subject: general
question: Which of the following initiatives is involved in the collaboration between iDEX-DIO and EdCIL (India) Limited under the ASPIRE program to link defence expertise with emerging ed-tech solutions?

options.text: ASPIRE (Accelerating Strategic Progress in Research and Education)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The government has signed an agreement to develop dual-use cutting-edge technologies and to link defence expertise with emerging ed-tech solutions through the iDEX initiative.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **iDEX-DIO (Innovations for Defence Excellence-Defence Innovation Organisation) signed an MoU with EdCIL (India) Limited under the ASPIRE program.**
 
• The partnership will extend iDEX’s innovation model to the civilian sector, addressing critical challenges.
 
• This collaboration focuses on promoting innovative technologies and leveraging expertise from both organizations.
 
• It highlights India's emphasis on building indigenous capabilities through the start-up ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX)__

 __
 
• Flagship initiative of the Ministry of Defence to foster innovation in the defence sector.
 
• Helps bring together start-ups and the defence sector to work on cutting-edge solutions.
 
 
 
• EdCIL (India) Limited__
 __
 
• State-owned enterprise that works to provide education-related consultancy services.
 
• It works on promoting educational development, especially in emerging fields like ed-tech.
 
 
 
• ASPIRE Program__
 
 
• Accelerating Strategic Progress in Research and Education (ASPIRE) aims to promote technological innovation through strategic collaborations.
